news.title: Robinhood stock falls 8% after big earnings miss due to weak crypto trading revenue
news.summary: While the trading platform’s crypto revenue tanked 47% to $134 million, a record-breaking surge in prediction market bets helped push overall revenue up 15% to $1.07 billion.

news.title: Paul Tudor Jones calls bitcoin the 'best inflation hedge,' warns of overvalued stocks
news.summary: It will be "really hard to make money" in stocks over the next decade, said the billionaire investor, noting that the S&P 500's valuation reminds him of the 2000 dot-com bubble.

news.title: CFTC sues Wisconsin in agency's legal campaign defending prediction markets authority
news.summary: The U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission added Wisconsin to the list of states it's sued over event-contract jurisdiction, most recently New York.
